**Nvidia's gross profit rose by roughly 57% from fiscal 2025 to fiscal 2026.** This is an estimate: I could not confirm the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026 from a filing, so that quarter is approximated.

**Fiscal 2025 (ended January 2025):** revenue was about $130.5B and gross profit about $97.9B, a 75.0% margin.

**Fiscal 2026 (ended January 25, 2026), gross profit by quarter:**

| Quarter | Revenue | Gross margin | Gross profit | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Q1 | $44.06B | 60.5% (reduced by the H20 charge) | $26.67B | Reported |
| Q2 | $46.74B | 72.4% | $33.85B | Reported |
| Q3 | $57.01B | 73.4% | $41.85B | Reported |
| Q4 | ~$68.1B | ~75% | ~$51.1B | Estimated |
| **Total** | | | **≈ $153.5B** | |

The Q4 figures are my approximation, not values I could verify from a filing. Company guidance for Q4 was about $65B in revenue at roughly a 75% margin, and my recollection is that actual revenue was around $68B.

**Change:** $153.5B ÷ $97.9B − 1 ≈ +56.8%.
